content: Transfer learning is an area of research that uses knowledge from pretrained models to transfer to new tasks. In recent years, Transformer-based models like BERT BIBREF17 and T5 BIBREF18 have yielded state-of-the-art results on the lion's share of benchmark tasks for language understanding through pretraining and transfer, often paired with some form of multitask learning.
